Package arcade.core.gui

Class GUI

java.lang.Object
arcade.core.gui.GUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionListener, EventListener
public class GUI extends Object implements ActionListener
Creates a GUI for selecting setup file and running the simulation.

When the model is called with arguments, then the main method in ARCADE is called directly and GUI is not shown.
